text: The motion authorizes the release of $40,000 in Section 42 funds secured from the development at 2175 Keele Street, Toronto to the Parks and Recreation 2026 – 2035 Capital Budget and Plan for Gulliver Park Play Enhancement project.

City Council on June 24 and 25, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the 2026–2035 Capital Budget and Plan for Parks and Recreation to increase the project budget for the Gulliver Park Play Enhancement project, on a one-time basis, by $40,000 gross and $0 debt in 2026, fully funded by Section 42 community benefits obtains from development at 2175 Keele Street in Ward 5 (Source Account: XR2213- 4201601), for the purpose of park improvements at Gulliver Park.
